hardware: dev VM, no GPU, 4 vCPU visible, 1.5 vCPU quota, 7.7 GB RAM
notes: tok/s is decode-phase: completion tokens / (total time - TTFT), measured by the worker with the model's own tokenizer.
Prompt tokens include the empty <think></think> block the worker adds for Qwen3 to disable reasoning output (see agent/worker.py).
Single request, not the 5-prompt benchmark set and not a 3-run median.

An earlier run with n_threads=4 (default = CPU count) managed only 1.41 tok/s and the reply contained a <think> reasoning block; 2 threads fixed the speed under the 1.5 vCPU quota and the empty think block fixed the output. Both numbers are real; the 1.41 run is recorded in BENCHMARKS.md, not hidden.
Demo fallback verified with the worker stopped: same request returns the unchanged demo reply, no nodefield field. Streaming verified with a real worker: SSE chunks + [DONE].
GPU utilisation, power draw and cost per 1M tokens were not measured.
path: POST /v1/chat/completions -> job queue (SQLite) -> worker poll/claim -> llama.cpp -> POST /api/jobs/<id>/result -> real reply
